text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap asked me to meet her behind the school building after training for some reason. I head there right away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There you are! I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There's something I want to give you. Here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hands me a transparent bag of carefully wrapped chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I thought I might try and make some chocolate since it's Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Creek taught me how, so they should be tasty.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It took me a few tries to get it right, and by the time I was done, it was already this late…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I wanted to properly express my gratitude for everything you've done for me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've been given lots of chocolate since I came to this academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I never realized how nice it is to give chocolate to someone else though.
choice_data_list: But why behind the school building?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Isn't this where you're supposed to give people chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This is where everyone gave me chocolate when I first got here—although people tend to just give it to me wherever nowadays.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Oguri Cap's grand appetite has won her many friends, she was initially someone people admired from a distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But now, she's someone everyone can express their feelings to anytime and anywhere. You could say she was destined for popularity.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: To the dorm pantry. That's where the leftover chocolate is.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The results of all the experimental batches. I think we melted about 20 kilos' worth of chocolate in total.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yep. Way too much to carry to school. But rest assured, it's all being kept cool!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Rejects or not, I'm proud of each one. I plan to eat too, so let's enjoy them together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And thus concludes my Valentine's Day with Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whew.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Nothing… I actually kinda feel relieved.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: My heart was racing while I was waiting for you—and not like it does when I run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I was wondering whether I should give you a lot more…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But when I finished this batch, I realized this was it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I thought about you a lot while making it. All those thoughts are packed into this one batch of chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So… Thank you for accepting my gift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I enjoy what little time I have left of Valentine's Day together with the ever so slightly bashful Oguri Cap.
